Commentary.Commentary: So, after the ODI series, India clinches the T20I series! But can they do the clean sweep? We have to wait to find out. The final T20I will be played on 20th February at 7 pm IST (1:30 pm GMT). Do join us early for the build-up as well. Till then, Adios!

Rishabh Pant is the Player of the Match. He says as long as the team wants, he is happy to bat anywhere. About the drop catch, he says it was Bhuvneshwar Kumar's catch but it happens in the game. Tells that he just played with the situation and is practicing hard. Mentions he and Iyer were just telling to each other to keep it simple and play according to the ball. Says it is not easy to play every match but he is enjoying every time. Adds at the back of his mind, he was happy how Rovman Powell was smashing as he will play for Delhi in the Indian T20 League.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India says that they are always at scare whenever they play against West Indies, they knew it would be very tough and they were prepared. Mentions that Bhuvneshwar Kumar was fantastic, he was calm under pressure and experience did matter, and he did execute the plans well with the yorkers. States that Kohli's innings was very important and he hit the ball very well and took the pressure off him while batting. States that he is happy to see Venkatesh Iyer perform, he backs his skills and he is very confident as a player, they need such players in the side. Also, says that the fielding was sloppy, they could have been better in the field, but they will minimize these errors in the next game.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies. He says Rovman Powell batted really well and the partnership between him and Pooran was good. He tells that they took the game till the end and is actually happy with the performance. Tells the start was not that bad with 40 runs and 9 wickets in the bank. Says they can see it from different angles. Adds they were slow in the first game and in the middle phase but they did well in this game.
Presentation coming up...

Bhuvneshwar Kumar is down for a chat. He says that he was believing in himself, and he backed himself with the yorkers. Mentions that Rovman Powell was hitting the ball really hard, but again they backed themselves and stuck to their plans. States that they did try a few slower balls, but he changed his plan not to ball slow to Powell. Informs that his body feels good!

With Rovman Powell and Nicholas Pooran out there hitting everything away, you feel it is an easy chase but sometimes you have to credit the opposition on how they played. The openers of West Indies fell after giving a decent start but it was then the Powell-Pooran show. They put up a 100-run partnership and looked like it is going their way but India's last three overs were top notch. It was all set up for West Indies to chase this down but the target was just too big in the end.

The pacers started well for India as there was swing but they didn't get any reward. The spinners then came into the action and got both the openers. The fielding kept India at the bay. Two catches were dropped and both went on to score half-centuries. Even the dew kicked in later in the innings and it needed something special from the bowlers. They were still in the game with 29 runs to defend in the last two overs. Bhuvneshwar Kumar bowled a splendid penultimate over and then Harshal Patel followed him with an outstanding one. Good job overall and Rohit Sharma will be a happy man.

Brilliant bowling from Harshal Patel, this game went till the very last over but Patel did very well, in the end, to defend 25 runs against Rovman Powell and Kieron Pollard. Meanwhile, Yuzvendra Chahal goes straight to Rovman Powell and checks his bat. You feel for him. He played so brilliantly but failed to take his team over the line. With this, India clinches the T20I series as well as they go 2-0 up. This is also India's 100th win in T20I history.
Slower ball, full again and on middle. Kieron Pollard just taps it towards mid-wicket for a single. India win by 8 runs!

Harshal Patel does well under pressure! A slower one, outside off, very full. Rovman Powell pushes it towards long on for a single. Virat Kohli is celebrating and Rohit Sharma looks like a happy man now!

SIX! Back-to-back sixes! And Harshal Patel is under immense pressure now! Another overpitched delivery, on middle. Rovman Powell has absolutely hammered that over deep mid-wicket for a big, big six! 11 off 2 balls now!
SIX! BANG! Very full delivery, around middle. Rovman Powell smashes it over long on for a biggie! 17 runs needed off the last 3 balls. Can Rovman Powell hit 3 sixes in a row?
Another beautiful delivery! Slower one now, full in length, wide of off. Kieron Pollard pushes it towards long off for a single.
Harshal Patel begins the last over with a yorker-length delivery, around middle and leg. Rovman Powell gets an inside edge towards the left of the keeper. A single taken!
A yorker, on middle. Rovman Powell digs it out towards long on for a single. An excellent over from the experienced, Bhuvneshwar Kumar! Just 4 runs off the over. 25 runs needed off the last 6!
A shorter ball, around middle. Kieron Pollard pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle and off. Rovman Powell drills it to long off and rotates the strike.
The skipper, Kieron Pollard himself walks out to complete the job. 28 needed in 9 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ravi Bishnoi holds on to the catch this time! A good wicket for India at a crucial time. A fuller ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to go over cover, but the ball goes off the bottom of the bat high towards cover. Ravi Bishnoi there keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a sharp catch running backward. A good knock comes to an end!
Commentary.Howout: c Ravi Bishnoi b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball, fuller and outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to drive this but misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rovman Powell drills it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. That brings up the 100 partnership between these two!
FOUR! This has boundary has ruined a good over for India! A short-pitched delivery, on middle. Nicholas Pooran has pulled this towards deep square leg for a boundary. 29 runs more need off 12 balls!
An off-pace delivery, full in length, outside off. Rovman Powell pushes it towards deep mid-wicket. Ishan Kishan does well to collect the ball quickly and keep it to just a single.
Slower ball, short and outside off. Nicholas Pooran waits for it and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Fuller ball, wide of off. Nicholas Pooran looks to drive this but misses.

FIFTY for Rovman Powell! A lethal innings so far! But his job is not done yet. A full toss, around middle. Rovman Powell drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Rovman Powell is not happy with that, he feels he missed out on the full toss ball.
Fuller ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran drills it to long on and rotates the strike!
Fuller again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran drives it towards extra cover for a single. 16 runs off the over. West Indies need 37 runs off the last 3 overs now.

SIX! Wonderful shot! Another match and another fifty for Nicholas Pooran! He brings up his consecutive fifty in some style! A fuller ball, on the leg stump. Nicholas Pooran shuffles across and whips it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
A yorker now, on middle. Rovman Powell digs it out towards long off. Single taken!
SIX! WOW! This is a magnificent shot! Deepak Chahar drops it short again, around middle. Rovman Powell picks the length and muscles it way over deep mid-wicket for biggie.
Full again, wide of off. Nicholas Pooran looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Rovman Powell knocks it down to long off for a single.
Very full now, around middle. Rovman Powell drills it to long off for a single.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! This is the last thing India needed! A shorter ball, outside off. Rovman Powell looks to pull but gets a top edge high towards the left of the bowler. Bhuvneshwar Kumar runs to the ball, and stands under it, but fails to grab the ball. Rohit Sharma across kicks the ball away in aggression. He just cannot believe it. Two taken.
Wide! Slower one, wide of off, full in length. Rovman Powell leaves it alone and wide is called!
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Rovman Powell is hitting every shot with sheer power! Another length ball, outside off. Rovman Powell hammers it down the ground towards long off for a cracking boundary.
On a length outside off. Nicholas Pooran cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Rovman Powell drags it from the inner half of his bat towards long on. Single taken!
Good-length delivery, wide of off. Rovman Powell throws his bat at it but fails to get any connection on that.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on!
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on!
Another googly, this time Pooran prods to defend but misses. 63 needed in 30 balls.
FOUR! West Indies changing the gears now! Flatter, outside off, a googly as well. Pooran smacks it to deep cover for a boundary.
Short and on middle. Powell mistimes his pull over mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! A flatter ball, on middle. Powell smashes it towards long on and it went into the fence like a bullet.
Fuller and outside off, driven to long off for a single.

A short ball, on middle. Powell on the back foot, looks to pull but is a touch late, it went high in the air and wide of long on where Kohli runs to his right and the ball falls just short of him. One.
A length ball, outside off. Pooran pulls it to mid-wicket. It wasn't timed well and hence they get two runs.
On middle, pushed to long on for a single.

Review! India have reviewed an LBW decision against Rovman Powell! The replay rolls in. There is a spike as the ball passes the ball, confirms UltraEdge. Rovman Powell survives and India lose a review here!

NOT OUT! FOUR! A low dipping full toss, on middle. Powell looks to pull but misses and gets hit high on the pads. The ball races away to the third man fence. The ball was dipping so Patel wants to take it upstairs. UltraEdge shows it went off the back of the bat. Went off the bat so given as runs.
Leg bye! Length and on the pads. Pooran goes down to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. A leg bye as it rolls to short fine leg.
Wide! A full toss but down the leg side. Pooran misses his flick.
Length and on middle. Powell turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A full ball, outside off, was the slower delivery. Powell swings across and misses.
Harshal Patel comes back to bowl. He went for 13 runs in his first over!
Full and on off. Rovman heaves it to long on for a single to end the over.
Fuller, googly, and outside off. Pooran guides it to point for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for one run.
SIX! 100 up for West Indies! Tossed up, full and on off. Powell gets underneath and powers it over long off for a biggie.
Floated full and on off, drilled down to long off for a single. A direct hit at the bowler's end and Pooran thought of a single but eventually bailed out.
Two wides! Full and way outside off. Powell leaves it. Pant fumbles to catch it and a single is taken.
Short and slanting on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
A full toss, outside off, dragged to long on for a single. 12 coming off it.

SIX! Sheer power! Short of a length, on middle. Powell pulls it with some serious power, flat and to the deep mid-wicket fence. It hits straight on the cushion. Replay rolls in and the third umpire confirms the same.
Full and on the pads. Pooran whips it to deep square leg where the fielder makes a good stop. One run.
A huge appeal for LBW, the umpire is unmoved, might be pitching outside leg. A full ball, angling on the pads. Pooran misses his flick. Yes, pitching outside leg.
Fuller, slanting across, outside off. Pooran looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! Cracked away! A length ball, on middle. Pooran pulls it hard and in the gap to square leg for a boundary.
Deepak Chahar (2-0-12-0) comes back into the attack.
Fuller, googly and on off. Pooran leans and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short, quicker and on middle. Powell pushes it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Googly again, punched to deep cover for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Pooran slaps it through covers for a couple of runs.
Wide! A short ball, way outside off, going with the angle. Pooran slashes and misses.
A googly, outside off. Pooran misses his cut.
A short ball, it skids through, on off. Pooran looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Drinks! That dropped catch can prove very costly! Nicholas Pooran is looking in good form and his wicket will be key. The dew factor might just slide in but the spinners are still getting some turn. An interesting passage of play awaits. 114 needed in 60 balls.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Rovman Powell leans and defends it out.
FOUR! WOW! He has crunched that! Tossed it up, outside off, and full in length. Rovman Powell gets down on his knee and slaps this towards deep mid-wicket for a powerful boundary.
Quicker this time, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! HAMMERED! What a shot! A loppy ball, full and on middle. Nicholas Pooran gets down on his knee and sweeps it high over deep square leg for a biggie!
Flatter ball, around middle. Rovman Powell knocks it to long on for a single.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Ravi Bishnoi has dropped Nicholas Pooran! Could prove to be costly. A shorter ball, on middle. Nicholas Pooran rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Ravi Bishnoi runs to his left a bit and dives there to take the catch but fails to pouch it. One run taken!
Fuller again, on middle. Rovman Powell pushes it to the fielder at mid-wicket. A successful lover for Ravi Bishnoi!
Quicker, outside off. Rovman Powell defends it out.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Nicholas Pooran knocks it down to long off for a single.
Rovman Powell comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT Ravi Bishnoi strikes in his first over and he continues his good form from the previous game! West Indies lose their second wicket. Much slower this time, full and on middle. Brandon King steps down the pitch and looks to heave this over long on, but he does so with the inner half of his bat, no timing on that as well. The ball flies high towards long on. Suryakumar Yadav there runs forward and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Ravi Bishnoi

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker one again, outside off this time. Brandon King looks to heave it over the leg side but misses.
Ravi Bishnoi begins with a flatter ball, firing it on middle. Brandon King looks to flick and misses.
A wrong'un now, on middle. Brandon King knocks it to long on for a single.
Wide! Loopy ball, full, spinning it away from outside off. Brandon King leaves it alone and a wide is given!
A leg spinner, around middle. Nicholas Pooran clips it towards square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, full and on middle. Nicholas Pooran blocks it out.
Flatter ball, quicker again, on the stumps. Brandon King works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Tad quicker, fuller and a leg break now. Brandon King steps down and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Shotter ball, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pulls it towards square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Full again, on middle. Nicholas Pooran taps it to the fielder at  mid-wicket.
fuller ball, on middle. Brandon King pushes it towards square leg for a single.

On a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran taps it to cover and runs to the other end. Virat Kohli collects the ball and has shy at the bowler's end but misses. A direct hit could an issue there for Pooran!
FOUR! Top shot! Another shorter one, outside off this time. Nicholas Pooran stands tall and slices this past point for a cracking boundary.
SIX! BOOM! Nicholas Pooran takes him straigtaway! A shorter ball, on middle. Nicholas Pooran picks up the length ad pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie!
Change. Harshal Patel to bowl now.
Review time! Brandon King takes a review for caught behind. Interestingly, UltraEdge shows nothing as the ball crossed the bat and the on-field decision is overturned. There was a sound though.

NOT OUT! A shorter ball, quicker one, outside off. Brandon King stays in his crease and looks to cut this away but misses. But there seems to be some sound there. A huge appeal for caught behind and the umpire raises his finger. Brandon King opts for a review! The replays roll in and UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. A successful review for West Indies and Brandon King survives! West Indies are 41/1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Fuller and slower through the air, on middle. Nicholas Pooran works it away towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
A googly, full and on middle. Brandon King knocks it to long on for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A boundary straightaway! A loopy ball, full and on middle. Nicholas Pooran looks to heave this away and gets a top edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Yuzvendra Chahal strikes and draws first blood. Kyle Mayers departs and West Indies lose their wicket. A quicker one this time, shorter and on middle and leg. Kyle Mayers stays in his crease and looks to tuck this on the leg side. But he is early on his shot and the ball goes off the outside edge high on the right of the bowler. Yuzvendra Chahal walks towards his right and takes one of the easiest catches ever!
Again goes for the pull but this time it is at 120 clicks and King misses his shot.
A length ball, on off, pulled straight to mid-wicket.
On middle, on a length. Blocked out.
FOUR! In the air and safe! A length ball, on middle. King lifts it high in the air. Venkatesh Iyer at mid on thinks he has a chance as he tracks back but the ball went over him and for a boundary.
A yorker now, on off. Mayers hits it to covers for an easy single.
A fuller ball, knuckle ball, on off. King defends it with soft hands to point for a single.
Deepak Chahar (1-0-6-0) comes back to bowl. Change of ends for him!
Sees King coming down the track and Chahal serves it on the slower side. He hits it to long off for a run.
A quicker now! Shorter and on off. King looks to pull but gets a bottom edge on his boot.
Wide! Short, slower and outside off, it stays low off the deck. King misses his cut.
On the pads again, an easy single as this is hit to deep mid-wicket.
Shorter, outside off. Brandon slaps it to long off for a single.
A googly, on the pads, this is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off. King punches it back to Chahal who half-stops and deflects it to covers. A single taken.
Time for some spin! Yuzvendra Chahal comes into the attack.
FOUR! Crushed! A full ball, width on offer and Mayers drives it hard through covers for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. King looks to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge and it rolls to point for a single.
Length ball, outside off, slower one. King gets deceived as he misses his pull shot.
Length ball, outside off. King punches off the back foot to sweeper cover for a brace.
BEATEN! On a length, outside off. King looks to defend on the back foot, but the late movement makes the ball whiz past the outside edge.
On a length, on middle. Kyle taps it late and to the gully region for a single.
FOUR! First boundary off the blade! A length ball, outside off. King smashes it hard, past the bowler and it races away to the fence.
A full toss, angling on the pads, flicked uppishly and to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, angling outside off. Mayers hops and blocks it to covers.
On a length, outside off. King taps it to point for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. King looks to cut but misses. Swing again there.
Ohh! What a delivery! A length ball, it lands on off and swing away. King looks to go big, misses it completely.
Deepak Chahar will bowl from the other end.
A length ball, outside off, bit of away swing and this is punched to mid off for a single.
Good delivery! It lands outside off and shapes away sharply, King has a poke at it and misses it.
Leg bye! A length ball, angling on the pads. Kyle misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A leg bye as it rolls to square leg.
FIVE WIDES! The ball movement takes it away! Full and swinging away from the batter, down the leg side. Mayers leaves it and the keeper cannot do much about it.
A full ball, outswinger to the left-hander, on middle. Mayers blocks it off the front foot.
Length ball, outside off. King punches it to deep point for a single. Harshal Patel with a little fumble but just a single taken.
A length ball, outside off, shaping away. King shoulders arms to it.
